Package com.aspose.cells_foss

Class Style

java.lang.Object
com.aspose.cells_foss.Style
public class Style extends Object
Represents the full style of a cell: font, borders, alignment, fill, number format, and protection.

Obtain a style snapshot via Cell.getStyle(), modify it, then apply it back via Cell.setStyle(Style).

Maps to C# Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Style.
